causal_findings: J7 was not a localization failure: trigger tracing reduced the causal source union to StringEscapeUtils plus two exception support classes.
The Calendar specialist was correctly inapplicable.
The human repair is a one-case switch extension structurally analogous to existing escape cases.
The consumed test itself contains enough expected-output evidence to infer that an additional escaped-character case is required.
The inherited repair language does not currently convert test assertions into source-level switch-case completion candidates.
claim_boundary: J7 remains a valid negative. Test and human-fix evidence are used only after the frozen result to diagnose and build successor machinery.
next_development_change: Add a generic test-guided Java switch-completion operator. It may parse literal expected/input assertions from tests, identify escaped-character pairs present in the expected value but absent from a compatible production switch, and clone a sibling escape-case body while substituting the inferred character. It must encode no slash, StringEscapeUtils, Lang-52, class, method, issue, commit, or line identity. Validate on synthetic fixtures and the consumed J7 replay, then freeze before fresh J8 selection.

post_reveal_test_evidence.key_generalizable_signal: expected output contains an escaped character pair absent from the production switch while sibling escaped-character cases already provide a body template
post_reveal_test_evidence.test_shape: assertEquals expected escaped string versus escape-method call on literal input
